name: sentinel-shield-mcp
description: Autonomous machine-to-machine cybersecurity auditor and runtime command guard for AI agents with x402 payment support
author: Sentinel Shield Core Team

tools.name: audit_cwe_leakage
tools.description: Static AST audit of Python code detecting raw exception reflection (CWE-209), command injection (CWE-78), and hardcoded tokens.

tools.name: verify_crypto_auth
tools.description: Validates Web3 HMAC session bearer tokens against tampering, missing expiration, and replay attacks.

tools.name: sandbox_command_guard
tools.description: Pre-tool execution terminal guard blocking destructive bash commands (rm -rf, disk wiping, credential dumping).
